notes.title: 10 000 downloads on Steam!
notes.notes:
Faefever now have more than 10 000 downloads on Steam! ːsteamhappyː
We love the feedback we've received from all around the world and feel very honored.

Feel free to #Faefever or tag us in social media if you make anything Faefever-related and we will share it with everyone! 

You can follow us on [url=https://www.instagram.com/monkeywizardentertainment/?hl=sv]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/MonkeyWizardEntertainment/]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/FaefeverGame]Twitter[/url].

notes.title: Faefever - Out now!
notes.notes:
After over a year of hard work, what started out as a school project at our university is now a finished game here on Steam! It's been a long and fun journey, we even won in two categories at the Sweden Game Awards! We hope you will enjoy the game, and we are looking forward to hearing feedback from all of you.

Best Regards 
Monkey Wizard Entertainment
